news.title: Ørsted plans 2GW Dadu 2 offshore wind project in Taiwan

news.title: Arenko’s software to operate Europe’s first battery co-located with offshore wind

news.title: Ørsted fortsætter sin strategiske fremdrift, leverer et solidt driftsmæssigt resultat og er godt på vej til at indfri sine finansielle forventninger til 2026
Orsted Says All Projects on Schedule After Impairments Hit Profit

news.summary: The new facility will support grid reliability and is expected to boost local tax revenue.

news.title: Good Energy signs its largest ever deal with Ørsted to support next phase of growth
